verdict.rationale: The only product-native multi-item action in the evidence is the MCP integration's ability to broadcast the same message to multiple team members in one request. That is a narrow form of bulk operation. The rest of the evidence covers per-item reads and single-record contact edits, plus a 10 requests-per-second rate limit; none of it documents batch endpoints. Missing for 10: bulk/batch API endpoints, bulk updates or deletes across contacts, calls or messages, bulk import/export, and hands-on corroboration that broadcast works at scale.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: broadcast the same message to multiple team members from your Quo number, without opening your workspace
